2607.20999.title: Workflow-Localized Mechanism Learning: Attribution-Guided Repair and Knowledge Reuse for Structured Agent Skills
2607.20999.paper_summary: Agent Skills package reusable procedural knowledge as external artifacts for frozen language-model agents, yet existing optimizers do not jointly resolve where a failure occurs in a workflow, which mechanism caused it, and how relevant knowledge from third-party Skills should be reused locally. We introduce Workflow-Localized Mechanism Learning (WML). Its Node--Mechanism Attribution identifies the failed workflow node, implicated mechanisms, and smallest valid edit target, routing single-mechanism defects to L3 resources and relational defects across mechanisms to L2 composition protocols. A six-module Workflow-Guided Skill Optimization (WGSO) loop then selects provenance- and scope-aware third-party knowledge, applies bounded patches, evaluates candidates, and stores verified outcomes in optimizer-side memory. On SpreadsheetBench, WML reaches 90.33 +/- 1.53 and 74.67 +/- 3.51 Hard Accuracy with DeepSeek and Qwen3.6-Flash, respectively; without additional optimization, the learned Skills transfer to WikiTableQuestions with 84.00 +/- 2.00 and 83.00 +/- 2.00 Denotation Accuracy. On Compiler-Supported50, WML attains both the highest hard-PASS rate and the lowest cost per successful task; compiled execution sharply reduces tokens and calls relative to a direct SkillAgent while retaining most of its successful tasks. Code and artifacts are available at https://github.com/xiaolin9595/workflow-localized-mechanism-learning.
2607.20999.paper_summary_zh: 代理技能包將可重用的程序知識作為冷凍語言模型代理的外部工件，但現有的優化器並未共同解決工作流程中失敗發生的位置、造成失敗的機制，以及如何在本地重用來自第三方技能的相關知識。我們引入了工作流程本地化機制學習（WML）。其節點-機制歸因識別失敗的工作流程節點、相關的機制以及最小有效編輯目標，將單一機制缺陷路由到L3資源，並將跨機制的關聯缺陷路由到L2組合協議。然後，一個六模塊的工作流程引導技能優化（WGSO）循環選擇具有來源和範圍意識的第三方知識，應用有界修補，評估候選者，並將驗證的結果存儲在優化器端記憶中。在SpreadsheetBench上，WML分別達到90.33 +/- 1.53和74.67 +/- 3.51的硬準確度，使用DeepSeek和Qwen3.6-Flash；在未進行額外優化的情況下，學習的技能轉移到WikiTableQuestions上，達到84.00 +/- 2.00和83.00 +/- 2.00的指稱準確度。在Compiler-Supported50上，WML達到了最高的硬通過率和最低的每個成功任務的成本；編譯執行相對於直接的SkillAgent顯著減少了標記和調用，同時保留了大部分成功的任務。代碼和工件可在https://github.com/xiaolin9595/workflow-localized-mechanism-learning獲得。
